articles.title: Rajasthan Horror: 20 Dead, 16 Injured as Bus Catches Fire Near Jaisalmer — Children Among Victims
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic accident struck Rajasthan’s Jaisalmer district on October 14, 2025, when a Jaisalmer–Jodhpur passenger bus caught fire near Thaiyat village, killing at least 20 people, including three children, and leaving 16 others critically injured.

body.html:
A tragic accident struck Rajasthan’s Jaisalmer district on October 14, 2025, when a Jaisalmer–Jodhpur passenger bus caught fire near Thaiyat village, killing at least 20 people, including three children, and leaving 16 others critically injured.

The bus, carrying 57 passengers, had left Jaisalmer around 3 PM. About 20 km from the city, smoke began rising from the rear, prompting the driver to stop. Within moments, flames engulfed the entire vehicle, trapping passengers seated at the back.

The Army’s Battle Axe Division, local police, and firefighters joined villagers in a massive rescue operation. However, intense heat delayed recovery efforts for hours. Nineteen bodies were found charred inside the bus, while another victim succumbed during treatment.

Initial probe suggests a short circuit in the bus’s AC system may have caused a gas leak, triggering the fire. Some reports also indicate illegal transport of firecrackers in the air-conditioned compartment, which could have intensified the blaze.

The critically injured were first treated at Jawahar Hospital in Jaisalmer before being shifted to Jodhpur via a green corridor. Authorities have also set up helplines for families and begun DNA testing to identify the badly burnt bodies.

PM Narendra Modi, President Droupadi Murmu, and Vice President CP Radhakrishnan expressed deep condolences. PM Modi announced ₹2 lakh compensation for the deceased’s next of kin and ₹50,000 for the injured from the PM’s Relief Fund.

articles.title: Drunk Cops Create Ruckus, Beat Youth With Belt — Suspended After Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has emerged from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, where two on-duty police constables created chaos in a busy market after consuming alcohol.

body.html:
A shocking incident has emerged from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, where two on-duty police constables created chaos in a busy market after consuming alcohol. The duo, identified as Constable Kapil Kumar and Constable Vineet Kumar, both posted in the police lines, were caught on camera drinking liquor, abusing locals, and assaulting a young man with a belt.

According to reports, the incident took place on Monday evening at Navyuvak Market under the Kotwali police station area. The constables reportedly consumed a full bottle of liquor at a government-owned beer shop, ordered biryani from a nearby canteen, and then began abusing people in the market while still in uniform.

Eyewitnesses recorded the entire episode, showing the constables drunk, misbehaving, and fighting among themselves. When the video reached senior officials, both officers were immediately suspended.

Sources revealed that the Kotwali police station staff initially tried to suppress the matter, but the video’s circulation on social media forced higher authorities to take action.

DCP City Dhawal Jaiswal confirmed the suspension, stating that a departmental inquiry is underway against both constables.

articles.title: Indore Street: Wife Catches Husband Shopping With Girlfriend
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic scene unfolded in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, on Thursday evening, just a day before Karva Chauth, when a wife caught her husband shopping with his doctor girlfriend in the Teen Puliya area of Nanda Nagar Main Road.

body.html:
A dramatic scene unfolded in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, on Thursday evening, just a day before Karva Chauth, when a wife caught her husband shopping with his doctor girlfriend in the Teen Puliya area of Nanda Nagar Main Road.

The man, identified as Sandeep Shami, an employee in the Urban Administration and Development Department, was reportedly out shopping when his wife arrived unexpectedly and caught him red-handed. What followed was a heated confrontation in the middle of the road, with the wife scolding the girlfriend and questioning her husband in full public view.

The high-voltage drama continued for nearly 30 minutes, drawing a large crowd. Onlookers recorded videos of the incident, which soon went viral on social media. Later, Sandeep’s family members reached the spot and tried to calm both parties.

As of Thursday night, no police complaint had been lodged by either side. However, police confirmed they have taken cognizance of the viral video and launched a probe into the incident.

The public spat — happening just before Karva Chauth — has sparked discussions online about trust and infidelity in relationships.

articles.title: “Why Was She Out at Night?” — Mamata’s Shocking Remark on Durgapur Rape Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gang rape of a 23-year-old MBBS student in Durgapur, West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has triggered massive outrage with her remarks appearing to shift responsibility onto private colleges and the victim herself.

body.html:
Gang rape of a 23-year-old MBBS student in Durgapur, West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has triggered massive outrage with her remarks appearing to shift responsibility onto private colleges and the victim herself.

Speaking to the media, Banerjee said, “She was studying in a private medical college. Whose responsibility is it? How did she come out at 12.30 at night?” She added that private medical colleges should monitor students and the “culture at night,” remarking, “They have to protect themselves. It is a forest area.”

Her comments have drawn sharp criticism, with BJP accusing her of “victim shaming.” BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia called her statement “shameless” and a “blot on womanhood,” while Shehzad Poonawalla said, “Mamata blames the beti and defends the balatkari.”

Meanwhile, the survivor’s father said he plans to take his daughter back to Odisha, citing fears for her safety. Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Manjhi has spoken to the family and offered assistance.

Police have arrested three accused — Apu Bauri (21), Firdos Sekh (23), and Sekh Reajuddin (31) — while another person, including the survivor’s male friend, is being questioned.

West Bengal Police assured that justice will be served, saying, “The pain of the victim is ours too.”

Odisha CM Manjhi termed the crime “highly condemnable” and urged Banerjee to ensure exemplary punishment.

articles.title: Dehradun Club Turns Into Fire Zone During ‘Flame Show’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident unfolded at Circle Club on Rajpur Road, Dehradun, on Saturday night (October 11), when a party turned into chaos after a fire-breathing stunt went horribly wrong.

body.html:
A shocking incident unfolded at Circle Club on Rajpur Road, Dehradun, on Saturday night (October 11), when a party turned into chaos after a fire-breathing stunt went horribly wrong.

According to reports, bartenders were performing a “flame show” using alcohol and other flammable materials when sparks suddenly ignited a massive fire. Within seconds, the bar area was engulfed in flames. Two bartenders sustained serious facial burns, while others narrowly escaped unhurt.

Police arrived at the scene after a video of the incident surfaced on social media. Taking swift action, the Dehradun Police fined the club ₹10,000 for performing illegal and life-threatening stunts. Officials also warned that if such acts are repeated, the club’s license could be cancelled.

Fortunately, the fire did not spread further, preventing a major tragedy.

articles.title: Petrol Bomb Chaos on Karva Chauth Night: 6 Students Expelled, 9 Suspended
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Meerut’s Chaudhary Charan Singh University after a petrol bomb blast at Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Boys Hostel on Karva Chauth night. 6 students expelled, 9 suspended — banned from hostel premises.

body.html:
#InShort | Meerut’s Chaudhary Charan Singh University after a petrol bomb blast at Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Boys Hostel on Karva Chauth night. 6 students expelled, 9 suspended — banned from hostel premises. Police have registered a case, detained one for questioning & are analysing CCTV footage showing students throwing bombs and shouting “Vande Mataram”.

* * *

A major disciplinary action has been taken in connection with the petrol bomb explosion at Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Boys Hostel of Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut, on the night of Karva Chauth.

The university administration has filed a case, expelled six students, and suspended nine others from the hostel. These students are now barred from residing in the university premises.

Meanwhile, Medical Police Station has registered a case against unknown students and detained a student named Sumit for questioning. He was later released on bail the same evening.

Police spent all of Sunday scanning CCTV footage and viral videos, which showed students preparing and detonating petrol bombs late on Friday night, creating panic in the hostel. Another video circulating online shows students dancing around a fire and chanting “Vande Mataram.”

CO Civil Lines Abhishek Tiwari confirmed that a case has been lodged and said further action will be taken against others involved.

Chief Warden Prof. Dinesh Kumar stated that identification of the accused students is ongoing. So far, six have been expelled and nine suspended based on CCTV and other evidence.
